      About this item

      • REDESIGNED WITH THE BEST SOUND IN MIND: Keep your Galaxy Buds3 Pro in with a design that delivers long-lasting comfort for an immersive listening experience
      • A SLEEK DESIGN MADE TO SHINE: Let your sound shine as much as you do with Buds3 Pro that light up¹
      • AUDIO THAT ADAPTS TO YOUR SURROUNDINGS: Immerse yourself while staying alert to your surroundings thanks to Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation with Galaxy AI²; Your Buds will automatically adapt to help you hear what matters²
      • AUDIO TAILORED TO BEST FIT YOU: Immerse yourself in the best listening experience, no matter how you wear your Galaxy Buds3 Pro; An Adaptive Equalizer for Sound Optimization with Galaxy AI allows you to get the most out of your audio²
      • EXCLUSIVE 2-YEAR WARRANTY: Includes a 2-year limited Samsung warranty (Amazon exclusive)⁵
      • SOUND THAT TRANSPORTS YOU: Your favorite content deserves our best and most immersive audio¹
      • THEY SAY “HOLA,” YOU HEAR “HELLO: Hear translations through your Galaxy Buds during face-to-face conversations using Real-Time Interpreter with Galaxy AI³
      • YOUR BEST BUDS FOR TRANSLATING CALLS: Hear translations through your Galaxy Buds while using the Samsung Phone app³
      • TOUCH CONTROLS WITH A PERSONAL TOUCH: Program your Galaxy Buds controls to do what you want — pause, skip, accept calls and more — with Intuitive Touch Control¹
      • DESIGNED FOR DURABILITY: Listen to your Galaxy Buds3 Pro with peace of mind wherever the day takes you thanks to a durable design⁴

      Product Description

      Meet the new shape of sound — Galaxy Buds3 Pro — now completely redesigned with improved hardware to bring you deeper into the audio than ever before. With Galaxy AI¹, your Buds create the best listening experience by optimizing sound based on your surroundings and how you wear them — while providing a snug fit for all-day comfort, no matter what you do. Buds3 Pro get how much you love your audio. From jamming while cooking to listening to your favorite show on a crowded subway to taking a work call, your Buds will adjust to the different sounds around you using Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation so you always hear what’s important. Plus, they’re packed with features to create a convenient listening experience — from auto-switching⁴ your audio between your Galaxy phone and your Galaxy PC to immersing you in the latest TV shows with 360 Audio, now available on Samsung TVs. And it doesn’t stop there — Buds make perfect companions for your Galaxy phone as you travel. Real-Time Interpreter with Galaxy AI³ allows you to speak like a local as your phone translates speech right in your Buds so you never miss a word from your local tour guide. No matter what you listen to or how you listen, we’ve redesigned our Buds to give you the most immersive audio experience with Galaxy Buds3 Pro. ¹Requires a compatible Galaxy phone and One UI 4.0 or later with 1.5GB RAM or above. ²Requires initial set up via Samsung Wear app on compatible device. ³Requires compatible Galaxy device. Samsung account login and language preset (English and Spanish pre-installed; other languages require free download). Results may vary. ⁴IP-rated for submersion in up to 3 feet of fresh water for up to 30 minutes (charging case is not water-resistant). If the earbuds or your hands are wet, they must be dried thoroughly prior to handling. ⁵Available only on products sold by and shipped from Amazon.

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      • Lashello
        5.0 out of 5 stars Unrivaled Perfection!
        Reviewed in the United States on December 1, 2024
        Color: SilverStyle: Buds 3 ProPattern: Buds 3 Pro OnlyVerified Purchase
        The Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro is the epitome of an amazing truly wireless earphone journey that users can ask for discerning sound quality, connection, and features.

        Upon unpacking these slim, shiny earphones that are the color of silver you will definitely notice the amount of effort Samsung has put into designing them. The redesign of the comfort fit means that these buds will stay intact even during the most rigorous workouts or prolonged listening to of music. The design of the headphones follows the contours of the head enhancing on noise cancellation thus providing the user with toch sound without interruption.

        When it comes to sound, and you will be hard pressed to find a better set of true wireless earphones than the Galaxy Buds 3 Pro. The 3D audio technology involved with the earbuds puts you in an immersive and spacious sound field when you listen to music, movies or podcasts. The sound optimization which is done through AI enhances the sound to meet your specific preference as a user. The end product is clear and dynamic sound that is at par with wired headphones’ experience.

        This is complemented by the noise cancellation function integrated into these earphones. Just like all Samsung’s gadgets the noise cancelling feature is very much advanced and there was no interference of outside noise when I listened to my audio content. Even when all you need is to listen to your music/library, or if you have a work/business to attend to, you can exercise the Galaxy Buds 3 Pro noise cancellation feature.

        But more is still on store, in the lines of innovation. The real-time built-in interpreter will ensure that you don’t leave a meeting or during your foreign trip stranded for words during the meeting. It employs an AI algorithm that allows you to translate up to 16 languages from the location of your travel to avoid communication barriers.

        The other fact that differentiates the Galaxy Buds 3 Pro from another is the battery power of this accessory. To provide a small overall volume, these compact earbuds are equipped with efficient design and mighty battery that allows recording 29 hours of playback time. This means you can listen to any type of audio content for days without having to plug your earphones to a charger.

        With regards to connectivity, it’s got simple pairing and smart switching between devices in line with Bluetooth 5.3. If you have any other Samsung device, the company’s well-integrated experience guarantees that your Galaxy Buds 3 Pro will always be waiting for connection.

        Finally, a 2-year warranty exclusively available on Amazon also means that your beautific investment will serve shelter for potential flaws in the device.

        If you want to buy truly wireless earbuds, the Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro has that feature down pat, robust sound quality, additional bells and whistles, and ergonomic design of the earbuds. If you intend to find lose a pair of wireless earbuds that may serve your active lifestyle whilst providing the best sound quality, Galaxy Buds 3 Pro should definitely fit the bill. You won't be disappointed.

      • Alex Kubitz
        5.0 out of 5 stars Its A YES from Me Dawg
        Reviewed in the United States on October 17, 2025
        Color: SilverStyle: Buds 3 ProPattern: Buds 3 Pro OnlyVerified Purchase
        Actually worth the price. The pinch function works great, the ANC is great, the volume is spectacular, and they fit in my ear for my 6 mile run today and didn't fall out even remotely (despite that i sweat a lot). The case is compact and everything is very well built, although the case feels a bit "plastic-y". Just be cautious with that. They are pretty comfortable as well, the M size nibs fit for me. The connectivity is of course very quick and took me less than a minute to set it up right. No fooling around with EQs necessarry either- for most. They sound fantastic out the box. If you're a bit of an audiophile like me, you'll appreciate the experience for all genres. I suspect if you like a lot of hip hop/rap/pop/electronic music you may want to hike up the bass and scoop the mids a bit. And for rock/metal/country/jazz/classical these will sound great as is but i lowered the 4k a bit and boosted the 63 and 125 to give it a slight bump in bass still for personal preference. Highly recommend overall, especially if you have a Samsung as it fits well into the ecosystem. No comment on battery life as this is just 1 good day of use, but I'm assuming it will work for my purposes and just need to charge up daily/every other day (if that? Maybe better?) which is okay either way.

      • Paxton Fellers
        5.0 out of 5 stars Best sound and fit in the series, but the AI is a bit "too smart"
        Reviewed in the United States on December 27, 2025
        Color: SilverStyle: Buds 3 ProPattern: Buds 3 Pro OnlyVerified Purchase
        I’ve used almost every iteration of the Galaxy Buds, and the Buds 3 Pro are a massive step up in terms of hardware. The soundstage is wider and the call clarity is the best I’ve experienced on a pair of stems.

        The Pros:

        The Fit: They feel more secure than the previous 'bean' or 'bud' shapes. I can wear them for hours without ear fatigue.

        ANC Performance: The Active Noise Canceling is top-tier. It easily drowns out low-frequency hums like plane engines or office chatter.

        Sound Quality: Crisp highs and a punchy bass that doesn't feel muddy.

        The One Con: If you like to sing along to your music, turn off the Voice Detect/Adaptive mode. The AI is so sensitive that it thinks I’m trying to start a conversation whenever I sing a lyric, and it immediately lowers the music volume. It’s a great feature for an office, but a total buzzkill for solo jam sessions.

        Verdict: Incredible hardware. Just be prepared to dive into the Wearable app settings to customize the AI features to your liking.
